To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a novel method to connect compact models to PCM measurements for advanced technologies and compact models.

we have developed a method to center the compact model parameters for an advanced technology and compact model, using wafer-specific PCM measurements, without the need of a direct calculation of the model parameters.

(i) the compact model parameter set of a specific wafer (wafer-specific) can be calculated from a limited amount (e.g. 10) of wafer-specific PCM measurements; and (ii) this calculation is performed in a two-step procedure, which is based on the wafer-specific PCM measurement data and the compact model parameters (measured on a golden wafer).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: Can we use a limited set of PCM measurements to center a compact model parameter-set for a specific wafer?
the question: How can a wafer-specific compact model parameter set be determined from wafer-specific PCM measurements?
the development of a method for wafer-specific centering (WSC) of compact transistor model parameter sets.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this approach is a very powerful tool to connect the SPICE model to the process and to the measured data from the process control.
this method is a very promising approach to center compact model parameters to a specific wafer and thus to increase the confidence in the circuit simulation results.
this approach is not only applicable to the presented technology and model, but that it is a general approach for the centering of compact model parameter sets to a specific wafer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the compact model parameters of a specific wafer are centered to the measured wafer.
we have developed a new method to connect the surface potential model parameters to the wafer-specific process-control-measurements.
it is possible to center compact model parameters to a specific wafer, even if the direct calculation is not possible anymore.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the compact model parameters can be centered to a specific wafer by using only the PCM measurements of that wafer and without the need for any additional measurements.
the compact model parameters are not directly linked to a single PCM measurement but to a combination of several measurements.
the surface-potentials can be calculated for a given compact model parameter set and a given set of PCM measurements.
